meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with who decided to give Owen a zero, and whether anyone spoke to him before they did.
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
I'm writing down 612 words and 11:52 PM. What date was that edit, Hale, and what else do you have besides that one line?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." That's not an answer, Hale. Either the zero is withdrawn or it isn't, and I want to know whether anything is on his record right now.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and confirmation that nothing is on his record.
What moved her: nothing moved her, because the 612 words at 11:52 PM was specific but had no date and nothing she could check, so she asked for more.
What cost ground: backing off with a maybe and an offer to remove the zero to make her happy, because it dropped your evidence and gave her the win without the apology or the record.
Try next time: when she asks for the date, give it and show her the version history page, and say in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her.
